name: STAT 5515
title: Design of Experiments
description: (Also offered as BIST 5515.) One way analysis of variance, multiple comparison of means, randomized block designs, Latin and Graeco-Latin square designs, factorial designs, two-level factorial and fractional factorial designs, nested and hierarchical designs, split-plot designs.
requirement_description: STAT 5005 or statistics MA or PHD field of study. Not open to students who have passed STAT 3515Q.
